label: Brush
depicts: Flat paint brush outline with a square handle and four short bottom bristles
use_when: Use when the interface wants a flat brush head with visible short bristles.
avoid_when: Do not use for the rounded or angled brush tools when the square handle and bristle row matter.

label: Brush
depicts: Rounded paint brush outline with a looped handle and square bristle block
use_when: Use when the interface wants a softer rounded paint brush with a looped handle shape.
avoid_when: Do not use for the flat or angled brush icons when the looped handle is the visible cue.

label: Brush
depicts: Angled brush outline with a slanted head band and curved lower bristle edge
use_when: Use when the interface wants a brush with a slanted head rather than a flat square bristle block.
avoid_when: Do not use for the centered flat brush forms when the angled head is the key visual cue.

label: Palette
depicts: Paint palette outline with three paint dots and a thumb notch cutout
use_when: Use when the interface wants the classic curved painter palette shape with paint dots.
avoid_when: Do not use for swatch or folded palette shapes when the curved thumb notch matters.

label: Palette
depicts: Vertical swatch block with two overlapping sample panels and one round mark
use_when: Use when the interface wants color selection shown as stacked sample panels instead of a painter palette.
avoid_when: Do not use for the curved palette board when the upright swatch panels are the main cue.
